programme.title: Recherche Téléspectateurs
programme.desc: Carly et Sam se battent contre Freddie et Spencer pour décider de qui aura le meilleur plan pour rameuter les foules sur iCarly. La situation dégénère quand tous leur plans tournent à la catastrophe.

programme.title: Nevelocity
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie veulent qu'une critique de leur émission soit faite sur "Nevelocity", un site très populaire qui poste des critiques sur d'autres sites et émissions en ligne.

programme.title: Carly veut rester avec Spencer
programme.desc: Le grand-père de Carly et Spencer leur fait une visite surprise. Il est préoccupé par le fait que Spencer soit trop irresponsable et fainéant pour être le tuteur de Carly.

programme.title: Espionnage
programme.desc: Carly décide de faire une émission montrant ce que font les méchants profs quand ils ne sont pas à l'école. Elle décide de suivre son prof principal, Miss Briggs, mais se retrouve piégée avec Freddie dans l'appartement de Miss Briggs.

programme.title: Champion du monde
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie essayent de battre le record du monde de l'émission du web la plus longue. Pour ce faire, iCarly doit durer plus de 24h d'affilée...

programme.title: Freddie a une copine
programme.desc: Une fan d'iCarly, Valerie, demande à Freddie de sortir avec elle. Leur relation se passe si bien que Freddie commence à filmer la propre émission de Valerie.

programme.title: Naissance dun artiste
programme.desc: Carly invite l'idole de Spencer, Harry Joyner, pour qu'il puisse admirer son œuvre. Quand Harry qualifie son travail d'amateur, Spencer a le sentiment que sa vie n'avait plus de but.

programme.title: La plus grande des fans
programme.desc: La plus grande fan d'iCarly, Mandy, est invitée sur le plateau de l'émission comme seul public. Mandy s'avèrera être plus une traqueuse qu'une fan, et les enfants vont vite vouloir s'en débarrasser...

programme.title: Poussins.com
programme.desc: Carly et Sam cherchent à féconder des poules pour leur projet de sciences. Mais les poules s'échappent de l'incubateur...

programme.title: Je ne veux pas dembrouilles
programme.desc: Carly fabrique pour Sam un unique T-shirt iCarly pour commémorer l'anniversaire de leur amitié. Mais quand Sam échange le t-shirt contre des billets de concert, les deux amies se disputent.

programme.title: On peut toujours rêver
programme.desc: iCarly demande à ses fans d'envoyer des vidéos d'eux-mêmes pratiquant leur plus belle danse. Carly, Sam et Freddie recoivent plus de 3000 vidéos et se retrouvent à veiller toute la nuit pour les regarder.

programme.title: Joyeux Halloween
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie tournent iCarly dans un appartement prétendument hanté. Quand des choses étranges se mettent à se passer, les amis se demandent si les rumeurs de fantômes ne sont pas fondées...

programme.title: iCarly
programme.desc: Spencer sauve la vie du chanteur de The Plain White T's et le convainc de participer à iCarly. Mais des choses étranges se mettent à arriver sur le plateau et l'on se rend vite compte que c'est Nevel qui essaye de saboter iCarly...

programme.title: Jai été collée
programme.desc: Sam est punie la nuit de la cinquantième émission d'iCarly. Inapte à faire l'enregistrement, Carly et Freddie font leur possible pour être punis à leur tour afin de diffuser l'émission durant la nuit, avec Sam.

programme.title: Mauvaise promotion
programme.desc: Carly, Sam et Freddie sont invités au QG de la marque de chaussures Daka, où on leur offre une belle somme d'argent pour essayer les nouvelles chaussures Daka, "Tech-foot", sur iCarly..

programme.title: La promesse
programme.desc: Carly obtient un B à un devoir d'Histoire pour lequel elle pensait avoir un A. Durant sa réunion hebdomadaire avec le principal Franklin, Sam change la note sur l'ordinateur et surprend Carly avec le A qu'elle mérite.

programme.title: La femme qui faillit être lynchée
programme.desc: Pendant la guerre de Sécession, Border City est une ville située à la frontière entre le Missouri et l'Arkansas, au pied des montagnes Ozark.

programme.title: La vallée des géants
programme.desc: Une colonie de quakers tente de sauver les séquoias géants d'un baron du bois.

programme.title: Un cercueil pour le shériff
programme.desc: Anthony Steffen, une icône du western spaghetti, incarne Shenandoah, un homme mystérieux qui rejoint une bande de bandits sans scrupules.

programme.title: 2 croix pour un implacable
programme.desc: Judy et Alex sont les deux seuls survivants d'une mission punitive ordonnée par le riche et impitoyable Moran…

programme.title: Texas, adios
programme.desc: Un shérif texan et son jeune frère traversent la frontière mexicaine pour affronter l'homme qui a tué leur père.

programme.title: Les Aventures de Billy Stone, le médaillon sacré
programme.desc: L'archéologue Michael Stone a passé sa vie à rechercher un médaillon magique. C'est finalement son fils Billy qui parvient à le retrouver, mais une mauvaise manipulation libère le pouvoir de l'artefact. L'adolescent et son amie Allie se retrouvent projetés dans le temps et l'espace.

programme.title: Urban Country
programme.desc: Une adolescente de la ville décide d'aller passer l'été au ranch familial dans une petite ville du sud pour s'occuper de sa mère malade.

programme.title: Cloudboy
programme.desc: Nila vient d'avoir douze ans, a toujours vécu en ville avec son père. Cet été, il se voit contraint de partir en vacances à la montagne dans le nord de la Suède avec sa mère qu'il ne connait presque pas.

programme.title: Ursli, l'enfant des montagnes
programme.desc: Un garçon doit braver la neige profonde de l'hiver pour obtenir un précieux souvenir de famille. Avant même de pouvoir commencer ce difficile voyage, il doit d'abord aider sa famille à survivre à la ruine financière, sauver sa chèvre bien-aimée...

programme.title: Triassic World
programme.desc: Des scientifiques parviennent à donner la vie à des dinosaures afin de leur prendre leurs organes et de sauver des humains. Mais quand les créatures s'échappent, les scientifiques vont devoir se battre pour sauver leur vie.

programme.title: Le Commando
programme.desc: Un agent de la DEA doit protéger sa famille contre un criminel, récemment libéré, et ses hommes à la recherche d'une cachette où des millions de dollars seraient dissimulés : au sein même de la maison de l'agent...

programme.title: Night Shift
programme.desc: Une nuit explosive durant laquelle un vétéran chevronné de la police de Los Angeles emmène un jeune bleu en patrouille et lui montre la brutale réalité de leur métier...

programme.title: Ride
programme.desc: Lorsque James, un chauffeur Uber, et sa passagère Jessica, passent prendre le charismatique mais néanmoins manipulateur Bruno, leur trajet dans Los Angeles se transforme en une véritable lutte psychologique pour survivre.

programme.title: Sur la route du paradis
programme.desc: Leila et ses deux enfants, Sarah et Bilal, ont quitté leur terre natale afin de s'installer en France. Sans papiers, et à la recherche de son mari réfugié en Angleterre, Leila, qui souhaite offrir à ses enfants une vie meilleure, tente de survivre et de les élever dans la clandestinité. Alors qu'elle retrouve enfin la trace de son époux et dispose de l'argent nécessaire, l'étau se resserre.

programme.title: La vie sans truc
programme.desc: Popolo, le plus grand magicien du monde ! Tu parles ! Il vient de paumer les jambes d'Amabilé, sa sublime assistante, dans le numéro de la femme coupée en deux ! Pour la consoler, il lui a promis de lui payer des vacances à la mer. C'est bien beau ! Mais maintenant qu'il est sans boulot, va falloir qu'il aille faire le guignol au Paul Emploie, comme tout le monde !

programme.title: Benidorm
programme.desc: Dans une station balnéaire vivent une jeune mère et sa fille. L'une vit la nuit, l'autre le jour. Elles ne se croisent jamais et le seul lien qui leur permet de maintenir un semblant de vie commune est un talkie-walkie.

programme.title: Cache-Cash
programme.desc: Jacques, 58 ans, a fait un AVC. À son réveil à l'hôpital, deux hommes se tiennent à son chevet. Ils prétendent être ses amis de longue date, avoir braqué un bar-tabac avec lui, et être là pour récupérer leur part du butin. Selon eux, Jacques est le seul à savoir où se trouve l'argent. Seulement, Jacques ne se souvient plus de rien. Jacques bluffe-t-il ? Ces deux hommes sont- ils vraiment ses amis ?

programme.title: Bad Gones
programme.desc: Matteo, neuf ans, rêve d'assister à un match de foot de son équipe fétiche : l'Olympique Lyonnais. Son père décide de l'emmener au stade de Gerland, mais le prix des places est au dessus de ses moyens. Le père ne peut pas acheter les billets. Comment va-t-il faire face à cette humiliation ?

programme.title: L'Amour du risque
programme.desc: Lila est coach love. Elle anime un séminaire sur l'amour et la séduction pour jeunes hommes en grande souffrance au Bois de Boulogne. Mais un jour, voilà qu'elle voit débarquer son ex.

programme.title: On ira à Neuilly Inch'Allah
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une manifestation de jeunes travailleurs de Vélib', qui apprennent la lutte et tentent de s'organiser. C'est l'histoire d'une joute entre l'image et le son.

programme.title: Boobzilla change de pneus
programme.desc: Leyomi Bum Bum, ancienne championne de tuning, filme le tutoriel de son dernier projet: Boobzilla.

programme.title: Giggino ‘o bello
programme.desc: Un vieux criminel, Nonno, se cache dans une cave avec Giggino son petit-fils.

programme.title: L'étrange disparition de M. Walter Werner
programme.desc: Où est donc passé Walter ? Alban semble être le seul à s'interroger.

programme.title: Entre chien et loup
programme.desc: Sohrab, un jeune soldat enrôlé dans l'armée, se retrouve face à ses congénères lors d'une manifestation.

programme.title: Le grand jeu
programme.desc: Mathias et Alex ont rendez-vous à l'aube sur un petit parking en pleine campagne. Ils se connaissent bien mais tout semble les opposer. Pourtant, un secret les unit. Cette année encore, rien ne pourra les détourner de ce qu'ils sont venus accomplir. Que nous révèlera leur entreprise mystérieuse et fantasque ?

programme.title: Je suis l'ombre d'une flamme
programme.desc: Un couple préhistorique tente d'allumer un feu...

programme.title: Peine perdue
programme.desc: Une fin d'après-midi au bord d'une rivière, un concert près de l'eau. L'étrange Rodolphe remarque Alex, jeune homme timide qui n'a d'yeux que pour Julia, parisienne en vacances. Rodolphe entreprend de l'aider, à sa manière...

programme.title: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés
programme.desc: Nous sommes tous des êtres penchés. C'est notre manière pour nous tenir debout. Deux combats, deux époques, pour une même soif de reconnaissance, sur deux histoires qui ne finissent pas de ricocher l'une sur l'autre.

programme.title: Troc mort
programme.desc: Deux croque-morts, à l'issue d'un braquage, se retrouvent dépossédés du cercueil et du corps dont ils avaient la charge pour trouver à leur place le butin des malfaiteurs. Cette brochette de bras cassés va devoir organiser un échange.

programme.title: Eve
programme.desc: Ève est un diptyque sur la démesure de l'amour et la soif d'immortalité. Eve et Lili, deux femmes enfermées dans leur Éden, attendent l'amour et la reconnaissance. Façonnées jusqu'à la perfection, devenues presque anges, elles défient le temps qui passe et les a oubliées. C'est une ode à la beauté, une déclaration d'amour à l'anticonformisme et à l'espérance.

programme.title: Victoria en ut mineur
programme.desc: Suite à la mort accidentelle de sa fille à l'âge de cinq ans, la vie de Bob a basculé. Convaincu que l'esprit de son enfant survit autour des lieux du drame, l'homme s'enfonce peu a peu dans l'obsession et la marginalité .

programme.title: Olga
programme.desc: Olga, épuisée, maltraitée par son petit ami, vient se réfugier dans l'appartement de son fils qui vit une relation ardente avec sa petite amie dans une ville brûlante. Elle se retrouve prisonnière de son désir, envenimée par l'intimité du jeune couple.

programme.title: Tonton Ivon
programme.desc: Alice, une adolescente, fait semblant d'avoir un ami imaginaire, Tonton Ivon. C'est comme une manière de se rebeller et à la fois, de sortir de sa solitude. Alice rencontre Pierre, qui laisse présager un changement possible…

programme.title: The Agent
programme.desc: Jong-seong, un agent fantôme nord-coréen, interrompt une vente d'armes illégale à Berlin. Un agent nord-coréen notoire met à l'épreuve la loyauté de tous les participants alors que Jong-seong se prépare à faire le sacrifice ultime.

programme.title: La Division
programme.desc: Dans les années 90, Rio de Janeiro a été secouée par une vague d'enlèvements. Les forces de sécurité font appel à des agents controversés pour aider à sauver la ville des criminels, mais aussi de la police elle-même.

programme.title: Mega Piranha
programme.desc: Une souche mutante de piranhas géants et féroces s'échappe de l'Amazonie et se fraie un chemin vers la Floride.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Un sorcier maléfique, Lord Tensley, cherche à obtenir la main et le cœur de la belle princesse, Lady Ennogard. Lorsqu'elle refuse, il l'enferme et libère un dragon mortel, qu'il contrôle, pour terroriser le pays. Il jure que, tant qu'elle n'aura pas accepté son amour, son dragon détruira tous ceux qui oseront montrer le moindre signe d'amour dans le royaume.

programme.title: The Sorcerer's Apprentice
programme.desc: Ben emménage dans une nouvelle maison. L'adolescent se lie d'amitié avec leur nouveau voisin, qui est en fait le célèbre magicien Merlin. Alors que ce dernier affronte la terrible fée Morgane, il enseigne à Ben les rudiments de la magie.

programme.title: Princess In Love
programme.desc: L'histoire scandaleuse et véridique de la liaison entre le capitaine James Hewitt et Lady Diana Spencer, qui a détruit un mariage royal et stupéfié la monarchie britannique.

programme.title: 21 And Over
programme.desc: Deux jeunes amis emmènent un de leurs camarades, qui célèbre ses 21 ans, dans une grande fête de carabins. Mais quand une bière en débouche sur une autre, la soirée tourne à la débauche. Personne n'est prêt d'oublier les événements pathétiques qui vont en découler…

programme.title: Une mère diabolique
programme.desc: Lorsque Jessica se retrouve sans le sou après avoir été ruinée par son mari manipulateur, elle jette son dévolu sur les millions de dollars que sa fille Allison, qu'elle a abandonnée bébé, est censée hériter. Si Allison accueille sa mère biologique à bras ouverts, la sœur de Jessica, Sydni, et son tuteur, Manny, se montrent plus réticents. Malheureusement pour eux, Jessica, impitoyable, est prête à tout pour s'emparer de la fortune d'Allison… même au meurtre.

programme.title: Tu seras à moi
programme.desc: Le harceleur parfait n'existe que dans l'imagination de Grace Winston, une femme qui tue son mari puis utilise ce personnage imaginaire pour que son voisin « l'aime et la protège » !

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: Afin de protéger une belle femme et son fils d'un braqueur, l'agent du FBI Malcolm Turner (Martin Lawrence) est chargé d'une opération secrète consistant à se déguiser en femme âgée obèse afin d'enquêter sur un crime antérieur.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronaute Roy McBride s'aventure jusqu'aux confins du système solaire à la recherche de son père disparu et pour résoudre un mystère qui menace la survie de notre planète.

programme.title: Waiting for the barbarians
programme.desc: La prise de conscience d'un magistrat d'une petite ville coloniale après avoir été témoin des mauvais traitements subis par les prisonniers de guerre.

programme.title: La promesse d'Irena
programme.desc: Varsovie, 1939. Lorsque les nazis envahissent la Pologne, l'infirmière Irena Gut est déportée et contrainte de travailler pour soutenir l'effort de guerre allemand.

programme.title: Turbo Interceptor
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Des personnes aux capacités surhumaines se dressent face à un gouvernement qui veut exploiter et abuser de leurs pouvoirs. Chris Evans et Dakota Fanning font équipe dans ce thriller paranormal palpitant.

programme.title: Sahara
programme.desc: L'explorateur Dirk Pitt part à l'aventure d'une vie, à la recherche d'un cuirassé connu sous le nom de « Navire de la mort » perdu pendant la guerre civile dans les déserts de l'Afrique de l'Ouest, tout en aidant un médecin de l'OMS poursuivi par un dictateur impitoyable.

programme.title: Turbo Interceptor
programme.desc: Jake est assassiné par des voyous de quartier. Il revient sous une forme surnaturelle (Le Spectre) pour se venger.

programme.title: American Beauty
programme.desc: L'existence de Lester est loin d'être parfaite. Il change quelques choses, devient plus libre, plus heureux. Mais Lester va bientôt apprendre que la liberté totale a un prix.

programme.title: Clerks, Employés Modèles
programme.desc: Le légendaire film indépendant qui a lancé Kevin Smith et qui a séduit le public par son énergie brute, sa comédie outrageuse et sa bande-son branchée. Clerks : Les Employés modèles voit les débuts des icônes Jay et Silent Bob sur un ton acéré.

programme.title: Clueless
programme.desc: Deux beaux mecs font irruption dans l'univers de Cher : un nouveau camarade d'école sexy et son ex demi-frère à l'esprit carré mais bien mignon. Elle apprend maintenant que lorsqu'il s'agit d'amour, elle est nulle.

programme.title: Clémentine Chérie
programme.desc: Une découverte de laboratoire vient changer la fortune de Monsieur Bellus : un maillot de bain extensible et perméable aux rayons du soleil. Or, un scandale surgit lors d'un défilé de "misses" car ce matériau ne laisse aucune trace sur les photographies.

programme.title: Coach Carter
programme.desc: Le récit inspirant de l'entraîneur de basket-ball Ken Carter, qui reçut des éloges aussi bien que des critiques pour avoir annulé tous les matches de son équipe, alors invaincue, en raison de leurs mauvais résultats scolaires.

programme.title: L'Employeur
programme.desc: Cinq candidats s'affrontent dans une épreuve mortelle où un seul remportera le poste convoité.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Close Up
programme.desc: La carrière, la vie privée, la filmographie et les secrets de vos stars hollywoodiennes préférées.

programme.title: Ultimate Countdown
programme.desc: Les moments les plus mémorables du cinéma et des célébrités sont classés dans cette émission captivante.

programme.title: Le sang du cartel
programme.desc: Lucas, adolescent dans une bande de D.C., voit une chance de sauver son frère grâce à un ancien combattant.

programme.title: Le 12ème homme
programme.desc: Il s'agissait de 12 saboteurs. Les nazis en tuèrent 11. C'est l'histoire vraie de celui qui s'est enfuit.

programme.title: The Neighbor
programme.desc: Un cinquantenaire au mariage stagnant se découvre une nouvelle obsession lorsqu'une jolie jeune femme emménage à côté de chez lui.

programme.title: Tous les chemins mènent à Rome
programme.desc: Une mère de famille un peu à cran, se voit partir en road trip en Italie avec son amour de jeunesse Italien, afin de rattraper sa fille rebelle, qui souhaite rejoindre New-York à tout prix.

programme.title: Madea's Family Reunion (Affaire de femmes)
programme.desc: Une matriarche qui ne se laisse pas faire tente d'organiser une réunion de famille pour rassembler sa famille à un moment où elle ne pourrait pas être plus divisée.

programme.title: Lucky girl
programme.desc: Ashley est la femme la plus chanceuse de New York. Mais sa chance s'intervertit bizarrement avec celle du jeune homme le plus malchanceux de la ville.

programme.title: Sur la ligne
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, la jeune et talentueuse Anna est sélectionnée pour la formation spéciale et secrète des jeux Olympiques dans la catégorie Sprint. Prête à tout pour gagner cette compétition, elle n'échappera pas à l'engrenage du dopage.

programme.title: The Love Gala
programme.desc: Lorsque Kate se voit confier l'organisation du Gala du Jardin de sa mère, le plus grand événement festif de l'année, elle doit trouver un compromis avec le nouveau directeur, au caractère opposé, du jardin botanique.

programme.title: Le Café de l'Amour
programme.desc: La propriétaire d'un café où tout le monde tombe amoureux risque de tout perdre lorsqu'une célébrité fait sa demande en mariage et se fait larguer. Elle décide alors de tout faire pour réconcilier le couple.

programme.title: Un Anglais à New York
programme.desc: Sidney Young est un intellectuel désabusé qui adore autant qu'il méprise le monde des célébrités, de la gloire et du glamour. Son magazine alternatif, Post Modern Review , se moque des stars obsédées par les médias et va à contre-courant des tendances. Lorsqu'on lui propose un poste dans le très conservateur magazine new-yorkais Sharps , c'est un véritable choc ! Il semble que Clayton Harding, le rédacteur en chef de Sharps , ait été amusé par la perturbation d'une soirée post-BAFTA par Young, accompagné d'un cochon déguisé en Babe. Commence alors la descente de Sidney vers le succès : il passe progressivement du statut d'outsider moqué à celui de confident de la starlette Sophie Maes. Au début, il est aidé chez Sharps par sa collègue Alison Olsen, qui cache elle aussi un secret. Leur amitié y survivra-t-elle ?

programme.title: I love my mum
programme.desc: Un duo mère-fils est expédié par inadvertance dans un conteneur de Londres au Maroc avec rien d'autre que leur pyjama. L'aventure les emmène à travers l'Espagne et la France pour rentrer chez eux et reconstruire leur relation rocailleuse.

programme.title: Beyond the Sky
programme.desc: Au cours du tournage d'un documentaire sur les mensonges des enlèvements par des aliens.

programme.title: Darkweb
programme.desc: Un couple de vidéastes organise des parties de chasse pour les millionnaires en quête de sensations fortes.

programme.title: Fire Girls
programme.desc: Un tueur à gages célèbre de L.A. tombe amoureux de sa cible.

programme.title: Arthur et Merlin
programme.desc: Dans l'ancienne Grande-Bretagne, les forces saxonnes venues de l'Est attaquent le peuple celte.

programme.title: Chair De Poule
programme.desc: Un jeune garçon déménage avec sa mère et sa soeur dans la petite ville de Greendale, dans le Maryland. Sur place, il rencontre l'écrivain RL Stine, auteur à succès de romans d'épouvante pour adolescents…

programme.title: Little Man
programme.desc: Un jeune homme pressé d'être père confond un jeune garçon qu'il doit adopter avec un criminel en fuite qui a la particularité d'avoir un visage poupin et d'être de petite taille. Mais ce dernier se rend vite compte qu'il vaut mieux avoir les flics aux fesses plutôt que des couches !

programme.title: Only You (1994)
programme.desc: Faith Corvatch, une jeune et belle maîtresse d'école, croit à l'âme soeur. Elle se pense destinée à celui qui porterait le nom de 'Damon Bradley'. Quelques jours avant d'épouser un homme qu'elle n'aime pas, elle reçoit un coup de fil d'un ami de son fiancé, qui s'appelle justement Damon Bradley.

programme.title: Amour & Amnésie
programme.desc: Un homme tombe amoureux d'une femme qui souffre de graves troubles de la mémoire à court terme.

programme.title: Black/White
programme.desc: Theresa ramène son fiancé Simon Green à la maison, pour le 25e anniversaire de mariage de ses parents, mais elle a oublié de mentionner un détail : il est blanc. Bien déterminé à mettre fin aux fiançailles de sa fille, Percy Jones va prouver qu'un père n'a pas toujours raison.

programme.title: Mon beauf, ma sœur et moi
programme.desc: Patrick a toujours eu une relation agressive avec sa petite sœur Marilyn. Mais quand elle ramène à la maison son fiancé star de la télé, Ryan, la guerre est déclarée dans ce film désopilant et cauchemardesque sur une famille qui s'aime à en tuer.

programme.title: Frangins Malgré Eux
programme.desc: A 39 ans, Brennan Huff n'a toujours pas de vrai boulot et vit chez sa mère Nancy. Dale Doback est un éternel chômeur de 40 ans qui vit chez son père Robert.

programme.title: Aloha
programme.desc: Un entrepreneur militaire reconnu revient sur le site de ses plus grands triomphes de carrière et renoue avec un amour de son passé, tout en craquant de manière inattendue pour une dure à cuire de l'Air Force qui lui est assignée.

programme.title: Appelez-moi Dave
programme.desc: Des mini extra-terrestres débarquent sur Terre dans un vaisseau leur permettant de passer inaperçus : la réplique parfaite d'un homme. Mais se comporter en humain s'avère bien compliqué.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: Dans l'Amérique de l'après-guerre civile, Bass Reeves, un ancien esclave devenu l'un des premiers marshals noirs des États-Unis, est chargé de traquer un dangereux hors-la-loi qui terrorise la région de Corsicana, au Texas. Accompagné d'alliés improbables, Reeves devra affronter la brutalité du Far West, les préjugés raciaux et ses propres démons intérieurs. Entre justice et vengeance, Corsicana est un western intense qui revisite l'histoire d'un véritable héros méconnu.

programme.title: A Soldier's Revenge
programme.desc: Hanté par les horreurs de la guerre, Frank Connor, soldat de la guerre de Sécession devenu chasseur de primes, passe son temps après la guerre à s'occuper de deux choses : le whisky et les fugitifs.

programme.title: Black Killer
programme.desc: Dans une petite ville de l'Ouest, la loi est entre les mains d'un gang impitoyable dirigé par les frères O'Hara. Lorsqu'un avocat mystérieux, James Webb, arrive en ville avec une mallette remplie de documents juridiques, il semble étrangement indifférent à la violence qui l'entoure. Mais Webb cache un secret et ne tarde pas à se retrouver impliqué dans un affrontement sanglant où la vengeance et la justice se confondent.

programme.title: Big Kill
programme.desc: Un jeune homme de Philadelphie, deux joueurs en fuite et un prédicateur mortel ont rendez-vous avec le destin dans une ville en plein essor qui a sombré dans la faillite, Big Kill.

programme.title: Mémoires diaboliques
programme.desc: Lea, une femme napolitaine d'âge mûr vivant dans une ville du nord du pays, a eu treize enfants, tous morts à l'exception de Michele pour qui elle a une affection morbide, convaincue qu'elle l'a volé à la mort.

programme.title: Dead 7
programme.desc: Un virus a décimé l'humanité. Les rescapés tentent de survivre mais ces petits hameaux sont terrorisés par Apocalypta qui contrôle une armée de zombies appelée Copperheads. Une bande hétéroclite de cowboys vont alors unir leurs forces pour les affronter.

programme.title: The Battery
programme.desc: Au cours d'un road-trip à travers les Etats-Unis, au cours duquel ils doivent faire face à des morts-vivants, deux anciens joueurs de base-ball s'aperçoivent qu'ils devront aussi faire face à leurs propres démons.

programme.title: The Blazing World
programme.desc: Des décennies après la noyade accidentelle de sa soeur jumelle, une jeune femme autodestructrice retourne dans sa maison familiale, se retrouvant attirée par une autre dimension où sa soeur est peut-être encore en vie.

programme.title: Ad Astra
programme.desc: L'astronaute Roy McBride s'aventure jusqu'aux confins du système solaire à la recherche de son père disparu et pour résoudre un mystère qui menace la survie de notre planète.

programme.title: La guerre des mondes: L'invasion
programme.desc: Trois amis fans d'astronomie cherchent le point d'impact de ce qu'ils croient être une météorite.

programme.title: Appelez-moi Dave

Avec l'aide de Sayaka, la fille du président du monde libre, et d'étranges alliés rencontrés en chemin, il doit traverser les ruines infestées de créatures démoniaques pour empêcher Rebi Ra d'ouvrir un portail vers les enfers et de plonger le monde entier dans le chaos.

programme.title: Joe Locke On LGBTQ Self-Expression
programme.desc: Joe Locke was doing his A levels on the Isle of Man when Heartstopper came out on Netflix. Two days later he had 3 million new Instagram followers. Fearne and Joe share their experiences of being thrust into the spotlight as teenagers and how it's affected them mentally. He explores his fear that his success might just be a fluke and why he's so keen to prove he belongs in the industry. They discuss how vital LGBTQ+ representation like Heartstopper is on TV, and why Joe came out twice.

programme.title: Millie Gooch On Alcohol, Consent, & Hangxiety
programme.desc: Alcohol-fuelled hangxiety became so overwhelming for Millie Gooch that she decided to stop drinking altogether and founded the Sober Girl Society. Now, with an MSc in Mental Health and Addiction, she's spent years exploring our complicated relationship with alcohol and what sits underneath it.

programme.title: Joseph Fiennes on Learning to Live With Uncertainty
programme.desc: Actor Joseph Fiennes discusses why he needs creative challenges to thrive, and how doubt can become a productive force rather than a barrier. He reflects on playing England football manager Gareth Southgate on stage and television, exploring parallels between their approaches to negotiating fear and encouraging vulnerability in men.

programme.title: Paul Whitehouse & Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE
programme.desc: Comedian Paul Whitehouse and his wife Dr Mine Conkbayir MBE, who has a PhD in neuroscience, discuss emotional regulation and neurodiversity. Mine shares her late ADHD diagnosis at 43 and childhood trauma, while Paul explores how physical health scares have changed his lifestyle. They discuss how the education system needs to change for neurodiverse children, the usefulness of labels, how to calm others with your own behaviour, and why this married couple choose not to live together.

programme.title: Joe Lycett On Fatherhood, Burnout, & Finding Yourself Again
programme.desc: Comedian Joe Lycett discusses identity, fatherhood and burnout with Fearne Cotton. Joe reflects on how much of his stage persona has become who he actually is, why paternity leave triggered existential crises, and how he's come out the other side caring less about what anyone thinks. They also explore losing inhibitions in the age of camera phones, why playing around and making mistakes matters as an adult, and how Ant and Dec have accidentally changed Joe's behaviour at hotels.

programme.title: Nicole LePera On How To Re-parent Yourself
programme.desc: Psychologist Dr Nicole LePera discusses how childhood praise and well-intentioned parenting can leave us with patterns that run our adult lives on autopilot. She explains how to reparent your inner child, starting with finding a childhood photograph, and shares ways to tune in with your body throughout the day to release stress.

programme.title: Alan Cumming: “My Dad Told Me I Was Worthless”
programme.desc: Alan Cumming's dad told him he was worthless, and his mum told him he was precious. Figuring out how he feels about himself has been a life's work. In this chat with Fearne, Alan's open about the ways he's allowed people to treat him badly, and how he's learnt to get comfortable with confrontation and setting boundaries. He also explains why the rage in the script of his new TV show triggered painful childhood memories.

programme.title: Emma Grede On Why You Can't Be A People Pleaser And A Leader
programme.desc: Entrepreneur Emma Grede, co-founder of Good American, discusses why women need to talk openly about money and know their worth. She explains why ambition isn't a dirty word, why you can't be a people pleaser and a leader, and why getting comfortable with failure and self-doubt is essential. As a mother of four, Emma shares her thoughts on mum guilt and why it's important that children see their mothers chasing their goals.

programme.title: Did Boomers Create An Economy That Fails Young People?
programme.desc: As Britain faces a lost generation of over a million young people not in education or employment, the author of a sobering report into the epidemic, Alan Milburn, speaks to Ava about what the government need to do to put an end to the crisis in opportunities for young people.

programme.title: Gerry Adams on Palestine, a United Ireland, and His Awakening
programme.desc: Gerry Adams, one of the most significant political figures of the last fifty years, speaks to PoliticsJOE about his political awakening, Palestine, a united Ireland, and the future of Irish politics. In a conversation days before Andy Burnham's coronation and days after the burning of nationalist effigies on bonfires across his hometown, Adams discusses the necessary next steps for Burnham's government, how to quell the rise of the far-right, and how to prepare for the end of the union with Britain. Topics include Irish unity, sectarianism, the far-right and racism on the streets, loyalist paramilitaries, the Jeffrey Donaldson scandal, media bias, and his father's IRA past.

programme.title: On The Ground at CPAC GB
programme.desc: Why are transatlantic forces of the right assembling in North Greenwich? Andy Twelves investigates CPAC GB, the new offshoot of America's longstanding Conservative Political Action Conference that hopes to unite the right in the UK. Attendees range from Tories like Liz Truss and Jacob Rees-Mogg to online voices like Young Bob and nationalist influencer Angloid to Americans who have made the trip across the pond. Nigel Farage attended the second day of the conference, and other speakers included Matt Goodwin and Matt Schlapp, CPAC's chair. Watch various factions of the right, from Conservatives to the Reform and Restore curious, fight for their ideas in speaking halls and a dimly lit expo centre.

programme.title: Generational

Different generations bring different perspectives, experiences and opinions, with plenty of disagreement and passionate arguments throughout.

programme.title: Sin City Weddings
programme.desc: Las Vegas, known for its neon-lit allure, attracts over 100,000 couples annually who choose to tie the knot in this vibrant city. Whether eloping or planning a destination wedding, Las Vegas offers a range of options. Couples can opt for simple chapel ceremonies starting at $40, or they can go all out with million-dollar weddings at high-end resorts. And for a truly iconic experience, they can even get married by the legendary Elvis Presley himself. From bustling marriage bureaus to gilded chapels, Las Vegas provides a unique and unforgettable wedding experience.

programme.title: Bling on the Bride
programme.desc: We are introduced to four planners from Austin, Texas, who collaborate to infuse their unique Texas style into every wedding they organize. Additionally, a planner from Southern California is passionate about creating dream weddings. Austin Planners:Kathie, Vivian, Jeff, and Kiley aim to transform a lakeside yacht club in Texas into a Moroccan beach resort for their couple, Lynsey and Seth. Since the bride and groom reside in Los Angeles, the planners must make decisions on color palettes, floral arrangements, and lounge furniture without direct input. Just hours before the wedding day, a hailstorm unexpectedly hits the lakeside location, adding to the challenges. Southern California Planner (Melissa Barrad): Melissa organizes an elegant wedding at a historical site in San Diego for her couple, Will and Kasey. Her primary concern is transitioning the formal ceremony setting into Kasey's envisioned reception ballroom within a tight timeframe. Despite the unusually chilly California night, the guests patiently await the celebration.

programme.title: The Wedding Planners 2
programme.desc: For some brides, it's not about budget—it's all about the bling.Bling on the Bride is a one-hour documentary where today's shiniest trends take center stage. Wedding consultant Tara Mandy and event planner Steve Kemble will discuss the latest trends and most innovative ways to add bling to any wedding. Jewelry is where it starts, from the traditional engagement rings of Tiffany & Co to the high-priced engagement rings worn by the hottest celebrities and the finest wedding jewelry creations of “designer to the stars” Neil Lane.You'll meet wedding cake designer Ron Ben-Israel, known for the edible bling that adorns his creations. And Mark Ingram will show you how the hottest wedding gown designers are using bling to make their hostesses shine. And you'll meet Brooke Webster and see the lengths she'll go to make her wedding day sparkle and why for her there's just never enough bling.

programme.title: Day of the Dead Bride
programme.desc: David can't helped but be creeped-out when this bride-to-be has wedding day visions that bring the Dawn of the Dead to mind? With Halloween far away on the calendar, David has his work cut out for him to make sure this wedding looks less like a vampire movie video and more like one of his elegant events. With a bride who has a lust for blood, can David create a wedding to remember without inspiring guests to run screaming from the celebration?

programme.title: Greek Goddess Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera's next bride thinks her fiancé is a "Greek god," and what else would that mean, but a Greek themed wedding?! Instead of an elegant affair, the bride wants statues, golden centerpieces and a bridal party outfitted in white robes. David quickly decides to tread lightly with this bride. For him there's a fine line between the Dionysian elegance of the brides' dreams and what could end up looking like a fraternity toga party!

programme.title: Bling Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera knows that every bride wants to be a bright, shining star at her wedding, but when it comes to his new bride Joanne Oleary, he's going to have to come up with a new definition for “Bling!”. When Joanne explains that she's hoping for the ultimate bling wedding: glamour and sparkly fashion at every turn, with her as the diamond in the center, she challenges David to outdo her vision. But as David sees what Joanne has put together, he finds a mismatched mess: shoes on guest tables, sequined fabric for the walls, and flashlights stuck to the walls as makeshift lanterns. Over three weeks, David transforms Joanne's wedding into a nuclear explosion of blinged-out fabulousness! New dresses and jewelry for Joanne's bridesmaids, a sexy and elegant new gown for Joanne, and for a surprise that is sure to knock her socks off, Joanne and her girls get to star in their own professional fashion shoot!

programme.title: Phantom of the Opera Bride
programme.desc: David Tutera has a special gift that turns any bride's concept into an unforgettable, dramatic event. And when he meets bride Amber Fleener, who wants the ultimate “Phantom of the Opera” wedding, David knows he's the right man for the job. But instead of romance and drama, David finds that while Amber is hoping for a grand production of Phantom, what's she come up with is more like a high school play. With cheap costume masks and fake flowers that look like Christmas decorations, and a venue that's more suited for a block party, Amber is in dire need of David's help. Before she knows it, David is revising everything, giving her a stunning and dramatic new bridal gown, putting her bridesmaids in romantic, classic dresses, and changing the venue to one suitable for the huge production she's hoping for. David even gives Amber an unforgettable rehearsal dinner with family and friends before the big night!

programme.desc: The first part of this journey through Scotland begins in the colourful and vibrant capital, Edinburgh. It takes us through the rolling hills of the Scottish Lowlands, en route to the wild, picturesque east coast and Aberdeen. There are new and exciting views behind every bend: heath-covered hills with a magically purple glow, beautiful lakes and forests of the deepest shades of green. The breath-taking camerawork for this documentary received the Columbus Film Award.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: A few thousand years ago, there were bare moraine ridges and barren meltwater valleys here. A landscape born in the last ice age, characterized by the edge of the Alps, gentle hills, moors, and lakes. And by cultural richness, not only on the islands in Lake Chiemsee, with their famous monasteries and castles. Long before King Ludwig II, the first people settled in the Chiemgau region. Finds of hunting weapons from the Neanderthal era prove that the land was inhabited even during the ice age, probably because there was plenty of game to hunt. During the Bronze Age, one of the most important trade routes from the mountains to the Alpine foothills passed through here. Then came the Celts and the Romans.

programme.title: Chiemgau, A Changing Landscape
programme.desc: Three times in the past two decades, the Chiemsee area has experienced "once-in-a-century" floods. Climate, wildlife, and landscape have changed, and it seems this transformation is accelerating. Species living in the flood zones are developing sophisticated survival strategies. Knot ants, for instance, place their queen in the middle and form a raft with their bodies, even conquering new habitats. Flooding is less of a disaster for nature and impacts humans more significantly.

programme.title: mareTV: Ibiza
programme.desc: The light of the Balearic island of Ibiza is magical and its trademark: The "Island of Light" is tiny compared to its sister island Mallorca, but offers the most beautiful sunsets in the world. That's what they say. They attract sun worshippers and party people from near and far. To the sounds of the famous "Balearic Sound" they turn night into day. This documentary documents the island in the balancing act between luxury yachts and traditions. Hippie culture, celebrities, pine forests, bays with turquoise water and villages with bright white houses: Ibiza has many faces. Mora (80) and Djin (67) have been drawn to the island for 55 years. They are the uncrowned kings of the hippies. But only love, light, air and laziness, these times are also long gone on Ibiza. Mora knits sexy jerseys for young hippies from morning till night. Djin helps her sell at the famous Las Dalias hippie market and works as a construction worker: chilling and no pension in sight. The virgin Carmen is the patron saint of the sailors. On her day of honour, a mass is celebrated in the port city of Eivissa. Afterwards, fishermen carry the Virgin through the narrow streets of Ibiza City down to the quay. And then Carmen sets sail. Several places on Ibiza claim to offer the most beautiful sunset in the world: In front of Cala de Benirrás, the sun sinks right next to the iconic rock Cap Benat, which the locals awefully call "God's Finger". The typical soft beats over the sea sound from almost all the bays and provide deep relaxation worldwide under the term "Balearic Sound". Some of the famous DJs are jetting around the globe for huge fees. But in the small beach bars, the Chiringuitos, the island sound is celebrated further. On the beach of Cala Salada the Brit Joe Burnley has the command over a troop of mermaids. The ladies squeeze into the tight mermaid costume for the good cause. With great grace they swim towards yachts that are forbidden to anchor on sea grass meadows. Charming but unyielding, they point out the offence to the captain and crew a creative environmental action to save the endangered Neptune gas, green lung of the sea and habitat for Ibiza's seahorses. The underwater photographer Manu San Felix is also committed to the endangered seahorses. Using a probe, he maps the coastal area around Ibiza and feeds the data into a GPS app. No skipper should be able to say that he didn't even know that his anchor was clawing into Neptune grass. On land, Manu is dedicated to breeding seahorses. His plan: He wants to expose the animals in the Mediterranean to Ibiza and Formentera in order to secure their population. Garages on the beach? Many bays on the island still have Casetas Varadero, boat garages threatened with decay. Fishermen once built them illegally. The picturesque sheds are therefore only tolerated, but may no longer be restored. The 83-year-old Toni Salvado still drives straight out to sea from his garage. programme.title: To the South
programme.desc: At the first part of his journey, the photographer is lucky to get some shots of rare animal species. Between the gaps of the rocky mountains he traces funny creatures: Pica. They look like a mixture between hamsters and rabbits. From his hideout Benny Rebel manages to observe impressive Ibexes, a kind of wild goats with huge horns. Equipped with a special microcopter and night shot camera traps he tries to get a sneak into the life of shy inhabitants of the steppe. In his adventure he encounters lonesome dromedary herds and discovers a spooky cave of hyenas. Rebel witnesses owls, snakes and lizards living between the antique ruins of the old Persian capital Persepolis. Benny Rebel also is interested in the relationship between men and nature. He meets not only ranger in the wild, but also visitors of the magnificent Persian gardens in the middle of rough deserts. Between the fountains of freshly sputtering water pelicans take a bath. Young and old people walk in the green paradises in front of attractive mosques. Unexpected the 43 year old photographer meets animal lovers on the roof tops of urban houses. The bet on the flying skills of their specific breed of pigeons. And like a house from a fairy tale seem the historical pigeon towers with their unique architecture housing more than ten thousands of birds. Finally Benny Rebel traces an Asiatic cheetah in the semi desert. Less than a hundred of the big cats are left in the wild. The nature conservationist and photographer decides to come closer to the dangerous carnivore.

programme.title: Wild Sex
programme.desc: Sex is at the heart of everything. It's the only real way of leaving a legacy - in the genes of the future. But there's more than just the act - it's the build up to it when wildlife shows its incredible diversity. It drives touching courtships and fierce battles. Hormones and sex drive are forces that shape behaviour and can change an animal's purpose and persona. This is the story of how wild things get sexy. Without sex, there's nothing. It's a driving force throughout nature. The act of sex is mostly to make babies, but let's face it, its foreplay that really counts - it brings out the best and the worst in the animal kingdom. Pre-coital courtship can give pleasure, but also gives the participants the chance to check each other out and make sure they've found the perfect match. It affects us all. Birds do it, bees do it, all the way through the animals kingdom. From fire flies who mix up their own chemistry sets to fill the forest with mood lighting, to mayflies that emerge on mass, by the millions to mate. Their vast orgies attract predators of all sizes. Fish risk their lives climbing rivers from the sea, and a barrage of bears and other predators - just for sex - but the mission is so strenuous it kills them, as soon as their eggs are laid, they wither and die. Sex and the hormones that drive it can turn cute and cuddly into a sex beast. It turns out the koala is a sex maniac, more into rape than romance. Many mammals, from guanaco (wild llama) to hippos chase, wrestle and bite their way to a romantic interlude. Huge male red Kangaroos even box. When it comes to wild sex, mammals are amazing, but its birds that are the real show stoppers. From dazzling peacocks to booming bustards, fighting turkeys to dancing birds of paradise, birds go all out on foreplay - though you sometimes have to wonder if it's worth it - after all that parading their sex is over in seconds There's a lot of effort for very little reward.

programme.title: Friends of The Jungle
programme.desc: When Olivia's Aunt Sophie is getting married and the groom has gone missing in the jungle, the girls fly out to the jungle in secret to try to find him in time for the wedding. The girls are super excited to be planning a wedding for Olivia's Aunt Sophie. There's just one little problem: Olivia learns that the groom has gone missing in the jungle while working at an animal rescue station! Not wanting to worry her aunt, Olivia, Stephanie and Mia secretly fly to the jungle to try and find the groom, Henry, rescuing a few animals along the way. Too bad Emma and Andrea couldn't keep the secret back in Heartlake City. Now, Sophie, Emma and Andrea join the others in the jungle to try and find Henry before the rapidly approaching wedding date!

programme.title: Can Of Worms
programme.desc: Lloyd moves in and tries to make nice by helping out with chores, but he just gets in the way. Pythor has awoken the Vipoids and the Constrictaurs and an all out snake war has taken over Ninjago. The Ninja are not faring well, when a mysterious Samurai shows up and saves the day.

programme.title: Darkness Shall Rise
programme.desc: With the Devourer destroyed, Ninjago is saved and the rebuilding effort begins. Without their Golden Weapons, the Ninja are stripped of their elemental powers. And with their flying ship ‘The Destiny's Bounty' destroyed, the Ninja are forced to find a new home in the city. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon resurfaces and gains control of the Serpentine as well as transforms the Bounty's wreckage to become ‘The Black Bounty'. The Ninja will battle Scales and discover evil has begun to resurface in Ninjago, while Lord Garmadon will successfully forge the Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.Just as the rebuilding effort in Ninjago begins, the four ninjas come to realize that evil has started to resurface with Lord Garmadon forging the ninjas' lost Golden Weapons into a Mega-Weapon with unspeakable powers.

programme.title: Pirates Vs. Ninja
programme.desc: When Garmadon by accident brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty – the ruthless Captain Soto and his Pirates - it is up to our ninjas to stop them from plundering Ninjago City. Sharing a tiny, one-bedroom apartment in the city, the Ninja take Lloyd to Grand Sensei Darreth's Mojo Dojo to begin training. There, they discover Lloyd has all four of their natural elemental abilities. Meanwhile, Lord Garmadon discovers his Mega-Weapon can't destroy, only create what the user wishes. By accident, Garmadon brings to life the original owners of the Black Bounty: Captain Soto and his Pirates, and they mutiny the ship. Answering the age-old question of who would win a fight between pirates and ninja, it's up to our ninja to stop Captain Soto and his men from plundering Ninjago City. In the end, Ninjago City is saved, the Pirates are arrested and Lord Garmadon escapes once again with their Black Bounty.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: When our heroes are invited back to Darkly's Boarding School, they discover it's a trap set up by Lord Garmadon and his evil replica ninjas created by Garmadon's new Mega-Weapo. Realizing how to correctly wield the Mega-Weapon, Lord Garmadon creates evil replicas of the Ninja to face off with our heroes. Meanwhile, Lloyd and the Ninja are invited back the Darkly's Boarding School, only to discover it's a trap and now the bad kids have seized control of the school. With the Ninja trapped in the school with the faculty, things spiral out of control as the Evil Replica Ninja arrive. As an awesome battle takes place in the school halls, the Ninja manage to outsmart their evil versions, and warn Lord Garmadon they're ready for whatever else he throws at them.

programme.title: Fright Knight
programme.desc: Using the Book of Fear, Jestro calls forth Whipperella and uses her to trap the knights in the dark woods where they realize their darkest fears. Searching through the dark forests of the realm, Jestro finds “The Book of Fear.” It's pretty scary. But he feeds it to the book of Book of Monsters, and he uses it to call forth WHIPPERELLA, a monster that can induce fear. One-by-one she uses her “knighmarish” power on the knights and they experiences their own worst fears. Clay fears not living up to the Knights' Code. Lance fears being a nobody. Macy fears never being a knight and Axl fears having no food. Aaron must take the lead because he's fearless he does everything with reckless abandon. It's not until he leads the group out of the forest – as they fight off the Whipperella – that they we find out Aaron's true fear – the fear of peace and quiet and no more challenges or high energy escapades.

programme.title: The Golden Castle
programme.desc: When Lance is cast as the star in the new remake of the classic movie “Ned Knightly and the Golden Castle” he doesn't anticipate Jestro and his monsters invading the set and ruining his starring role. It's movie time! Lance does something very Lance: he agrees to star in a movie about remake of a classic film in Knighton: “The Golden Castle.” While pillaging a village, Jestro and the Book of Monsters see a movie poster for “The Golden Castle” and the book says the legendary Golden Castle is filled with riches! Jestro explains that it's just a dumb movie and that it's not real. It's all based on a “script.” The Book, who's been shelved for many years, wants to eat the movie script to learn more about the modern world. On the set of the movie, Lance has invited the other Knights to act as extras. When they see how Lance is being portrayed, they're incensed. When Jestro attacks the movie set to get the script for his book to eat, the film director keeps rolling. This battle footage is fantastic! The Knights defeat Jestro even though the movie set is trashed. The director will make it work. At the premier of the movie, Lance is embarrassed to see that he's been reduced to comic relief for the realm's bravest Knight…Macy! The director has now made her a star.

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Black Knight
programme.desc: It seems the NEXO-Knights are attacking villages throughout the realm! But why? A mysterious Black Knight appears to defend the cities from the rogue NEXO-villains! Jestro, happy he has the REAL Book of Deception, uses it to create bad versions of the NEXO-Knights. The “fake” knights then attack villages and hamlets. When the real NEXO-Knights arrive, they're booed and pelted with food. Why does everyone hate them? To make matters more confusing, a giant Mech Suit in black – The BLACK KNIGHT – appears to defend the kingdom's villages from the fake knights. The Black Knight ends up being very powerful and throws Jestro and his fake knights for a loop. He's cool and mysterious. But when the fake Knights get the better of him, the REAL NEXO-Knights appear to fend them off and learn their deceptive secret. The Knights save the Black Knight and they open him up to find…young ROBIN! (He used a deep, deceptive voice.) The Knights realize that Robin has potential. But maybe he still has some learning to do.

programme.title: Legendary Places, Ninjago's Most Wanted

programme.title: The Oni And The Dragon
programme.desc: While Princess Harumi learns to adjust to the life of a Ninja, Lloyd and Jay search for answers about the Oni Masks at Mystake's Tea house, while Cole and Zane attempt to infiltrate the Sons of Garmadon biker gang. Remembering that Lloyd managed to arrest one of the gang members at Borg Tower, the Ninja decide to interrogate him to ascertain the location of the third Oni Mask. In order to get him to talk, however, Cole suggests they visit MYSTAKE'S TEA HOUSE to obtain some "truth tea." The truth-tea backfires spectacularly when Cole accidentally switches cups and drinks the tea himself. Zane is able to salvage the situation, however, and obtains a lead. He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Cole assumes the alter ego “Rocky Dangerbuff," while Zane adopts the subtler moniker "Snake Jaguar." In order to earn the gang's trust, Cole performs a karaoke routine that is a smash success. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. Cole is taken prisoner while Zane is invited back to the Sons of Garmadon's secret base.

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories
programme.sub-title: Terrifying True Story About Monsters And Those Who Fear Them
programme.desc: Are you afraid of monsters? Sure you are! Let me tell you a scary story about a boy who experienced a real fear…This story happened on an abandoned tractor factory. The boy lost a scoop from his toy-tractor and decided to look for it at the factory. So he goes up the stairs and sees a large female monster, who was about to paint her lips with a roller! As he kept walking he noticed more monsters playing domino! The boy was very terrified and about to cry, when he learnt that it was just a movie set and all the monsters were not real! They were just actors…Finally the boy realized that all the monsters from the books and movies are not real at all! But if want to see a real monster- watch a fly under a microscope!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Wolf and the Seven Young Kids
programme.desc: This educative tale teaches us that caution should never be dismissed. Mother-Goat goes to pick up cabbage, leaving her seven kids alone at home. Hungry Wolf tries to get into the house imitating mother Goat's voice to fool the little yeanlings. He manages to deceive six kids, but the seventh, the smallest one, manages to hide in the oven. The Wolf tries to get into the house through the chimney, but here comes Mother-Goat and finds her seventh kid. She melts the stove, and the Wolf rushes into the forest with his tail burnt. The other six kids come back home and finally the family reunites.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.sub-title: The Fox and the Rolling Pin
programme.desc: This is the story about the Fox, the Cat and the Rooster. The sneaky Fox wanted to fool the Cat in order to eat the Rooster and get a rolling-pin. No matter how the Fox tried to butter up the Cat, he denied hand over the Rooster to the Fox. To teach her a lesson, the Cat got into a bag himself and when the Fox opened it in order to eat the Rooster, the Cat jumped out of it and frightened her. The point of the story is that “if you are well off you don't seek better”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. programme.title: Golden Time Ep.10
programme.desc: Wonguk's condition suddenly deteriorates, forcing Minwoo and Jaein to rush into emergency treatment. As the media proposes producing a documentary about Wonguk's story, the hospital chairman orders Minjun to save the patient—regardless of who performs the surgery.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.11
programme.desc: The chairman asks Inhyuk what is needed to establish a trauma center, leaving Inhyuk torn over whether to bring the highly skilled Euna onto the team. Meanwhile, Inhyuk, Jaein, and Minwoo face a harrowing dilemma: deciding who to operate on first—a kidnapper who knows the child's whereabouts, or an injured detective.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.12
programme.desc: Confronted once again with moments of solitude and choice at the patient's bedside, Minwoo and Jaein are forced to reflect on what it truly means to face a life alone. Meanwhile, a patient with a shattered pelvis is rushed in, and Seongjin—who has fellowship experience in pelvic surgery—comes down from Orthopedics, only to hesitate over whether to proceed with the operation.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.13
programme.desc: During a dinner together, Inhyuk offers his congratulations to Euna and her fiancé, but an unmistakable tension lingers between the two men. Meanwhile, the ER is flooded with patients stung by jellyfish after a seaside outing—only to be thrown into further chaos when three men and women arrive with shotgun wounds.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.14
programme.desc: As Minwoo and Jaein clash over opposing views on amputating Wonguk's leg, the announcement of support for a new trauma center further clouds the decision on whether to proceed with surgery. Meanwhile, Minwoo struggles to understand Jaein's unusually sympathetic approach toward the kidnapper Yoo Seung-cheol.

programme.title: Golden Time Ep.15
programme.desc: Though Wonguk's leg amputation is successfully completed and the team breathes a collective sigh of relief, Minwoo is left conflicted as he gazes at the severed limb. Watching Euna hand over her duties and prepare to leave for Canada, Inhyuk is overcome with memories from the past.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is risking city-pop songwriter nokdu! nokdu made his big debut in 2018 with the single Say My Name. As a graduate of The Liverpool Institute for Performing Arts founded by Paul McCartney and Mark Featherstone-Witty he covers a wide range of genres in his music ranging from Brit-pop to punk to R&B. Backed up by his academic background he boasts his outstanding ability not only as a songwriter but also a lyricist producer and singer. Also known for his stage manners he is quickly capturing the ears and souls of countless listeners. Currently he's taking part in the competition program Super Band 2. His fantastic performance in the show definitely makes us anticipate his future as a musician. In this episode nokdu performs Stay With Me Wona and more to show off the essence of his artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet this talented artist!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the sensual pop-duo WeAreYoung! Composed of keyboardist and vocalist KIM Kyung-min and guitarist and vocalist GU Ki-hoon this duo made themselves known to the public with their heartfelt songs about youth and love. Thanks to their outstanding musicality they won the 2017 Shinhan Card Rookie Award the Silver Prize at the 2017 Martin Contest and Best Rookie at the Beautiful Mint Life 2018. This year they were chosen as recipients of the MUSE ON 2021 which aims to connect musicians and fans during the COVID-19 pandemic. Earlier this year WeAreYoung announced their much-anticipated comeback after completing their mandatory military duties and they are bound to impress once again with their songs A Day Full Of You Let's not do that Only I Love You and more. Tune in to I'm LIVE and meet these two talented musicians!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: I'm LIVE presents three special episodes in commemoration of the end of the year and having a live audience for the first time in 2 years! The trilogy is composed of Christmas Special Year-End Special and New-Year Special and the guest of the Christmas Special Episode is Lee Jin ah. Lee Jin ah is a pop/jazz singer-songwriter known for her exceptional piano playing and composition capabilities. Her jazz-based music covering pop R&B hip-hop ballads and more has long been supported with enthusiasm by the public and also by fellow musicians and she always comforts the hearts of listeners with her genuine heartfelt message. In an effort to widen her artistry she made her debut as a film music director in May this year she made her debut as a film music director with Kids Are Fine. In this Christmas special edition Lee Jin ah performs The Wall Blocks Me Noisily Everywhere Awake Yum Yum Yum and her own version of Santa Claus Is Coming To Town. I'm LIVE allows musicians and fans to interact up-close within a distance of 1 meter. Numerous big names and rookies in the Korean music scene including Jannabi 10CM HYUKOH SE SO NEON CNBLUE Jeongmilla BIBI NIve and Lydia Lee have participated in the show. Also only those who have been fully vaccinated (defined as more than 14 days after the final vaccine dose) can participate in the live recording as an audience.

programme.title: Sharanam
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: Lost Recipes
programme.desc: Lost Recipes is all about the food which is diffused into the pages of history and the rediscovery of a tradition that once was. Our host Aditya Bal is on a quest to unearth the once-popular culinary traditions through thirteen regions in India.But these recipes are no longer found in cookbooks, old or new, and seem to have evolved with time. Aditya must turn back the clock and wade through folk and lore to find the original, Lost Recipes.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan
programme.desc: Raja Rasoi Aur Anya Kahaniyaan is a culinary history show that explores the food of the royals and their erstwhile states. The show takes it's viewers through an amazing journey of anecdotes, folktales, architecture, art, history and landscape and delves into the unique customs and traditions of the various provinces. All these culminate into beautiful renditions of the recipes unique to those regions. This new season of Raja Rasoi aur Anya Kahaniyaan focuses on the royal families as protagonists and explores their personal stories and journeys that shaped their present day food practices.

programme.title: Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: Indipedia
programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: Kahi Suni
programme.desc: In a land steeped in mysticism, spirituality, and religion, the imagination of the followers has much room to flourish. Stories abound – some based on truth and some only on fractions of the truth. Nevertheless, these stories have enchanted their listeners for eons. Kahi Suni packs away our skepticism and takes us on a ride through the legendary tales of India. Each destination covered in the episodes has been the birthplace of a legend and each legend has given rise to the recognition of that location. Following our host from north to south and east to west, we journey through the land of myths of legends uncovering the origins of evIery story.

programme.title: Hispano Suiza showcases its history in the Peralada Castle Museum
programme.desc: The history of Hispano Suiza is showcased, for the very first time, in the Peralada Castle Museum (Girona, Spain) where visitors will be able to contemplate the past and present of the legendary car brand founded in 1904 by Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt. The Hispano Suiza Room will close the usual tour of the Peralada Castle Museum. After years of researching to gather the largest number of pieces and objects related to its history, Hispano Suiza becomes part of this important collection. The Hispano Suiza exhibition encompasses a journey through various decades: from the beginning of the 20th century, when Hispano Suiza was founded, to the present day. After passing through a luxurious hall, the public will be able to visit a recreation of the offices of Damián Mateu and Mark Birkigt, where countless business and technical ideas, emerged and took shape, turning Hispano Suiza into a point of reference, for luxury, comfort and technical solutions. In this area, the original painting 'Dame with a mink' by Ramon Casas takes pride of place: it was used as an illustration on the company's original shares.

programme.title: TechDay Digital Light
programme.desc: Safety and customer satisfaction come first at Audi. They are part and parcel of the success of the company with the four rings. In that context, light technology is steadily growing more important and creating a wider range of possibilities and perspectives, from added safety for the driver, to external communication and individualization. Systematic light digitization is making all of this possible. It is particularly visible in the new Audi A8: the forward-looking Digital Matrix LED headlights and digital OLED rear lights raise the customer experience to a whole new level: for the first time in any Audi model, light is completely digitized. The car can be individualized even further through its digital OLED rear lights. The Digital Matrix LED headlights also include three new functions: advanced traffic information, a lane light with direction indicator lights on highways, and an orientation light on country roads. These features not only demonstrate Audi's “Vorsprung durch Technik,” they also add value.

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

programme.desc: The new GLC is immediately recognisable as a member of the Mercedes-Benz SUV family. Standard equipment includes the AVANTGARDE exterior with Chrome package including chrome window surrounds and a new, chrome-look simulated underguard. This adds striking design features and enhances the unique proportions of the vehicle. One of the defining design highlights of the GLC is the redesigned front end, with headlamps that connect directly to the radiator grille to emphasise the vehicle's width, and the new radiator grille as part of the standard AVANTGARDE exterior, which now has a chrome surround and a sporty louvre in matt grey with chrome trim. The AMG Line has a radiator grille with Mercedes-Benz pattern. The body design is characterised by a full, spanned surface design enriched with precisely shaped edges in the sides. These emphasise the proportions, accentuate the muscular wheel arches and create a balance between elegance and off-road performance. Wheel arch liners in the vehicle colour are available from the AMG Line upwards for the first time. These accentuate the sportiness of the AMG Line, as optional equipment in conjunction with mixed tyres. Also available as an optional extra are easy-entry running boards and, from the AMG Line upwards, a Night package.

programme.desc: With the luxury saloon EQS and the sporty executive saloon EQE, Mercedes-Benz has entered a new, all-electric era in the upper market segments as well. The EQS SUV, the third model series with this architecture developed for electric vehicles, will soon follow. The SUV offers plenty of space, comfort and connectivity for up to seven passengers in its avant-garde, luxurious interior. Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. The new EQS SUV shares the long wheelbase (3210 millimetres) with the EQS Saloon, but is over 20 centimetres higher. The dimensions in detail: 5125/1959/1718 millimetres (length/width/height). The interior dimensions benefit from these generous SUV dimensions and from the advantages of the purpose design tailored to the electric platform. The second row of seats can be electrically adjusted as standard. Up to four golf bags fit in the boot. A third row of seats with two additional individual seats and extensive comfort features for all passengers is available as an option.

programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.
